gaps.sentence: The protesters set ___ at dawn from the village square.
gaps.explanation: set off/out = begin a journey; set up = establish.

gaps.sentence: The meeting has been ___ off until Thursday.
gaps.explanation: 'Put off' = postpone to a later time.

gaps.sentence: Many consumers now opt ___ cheaper brands.
The film didn't live up ___ my expectations.
gaps.explanation: live up TO something = be as good as expected.

gaps.sentence: The ministry tried to play ___ the incident.
gaps.explanation: play down = make something seem less important (opposite: play up).

gaps.sentence: She came ___ with a brilliant solution to the problem.
gaps.explanation: come up with = produce an idea/plan/solution.

gaps.sentence: Prices levelled ___ after the crazy spring market.
gaps.explanation: level off = stop rising or falling and stay the same.

gaps.sentence: The store decided to branch ___ into online sales.
gaps.explanation: branch out = start doing something new and different.
